description: First-wins dedup through a region alias rather than a language alias. Loads hy-AM and en with fallback en. CldrLocaleData.fallbackLocalesFor(hy-SU) is [hy-SU, hy, hy-AM] and canonicalLanguageTag('hy-SU') is 'hy-AM' (both verified against the library), so localizedStringsFor maps the requested hy-SU onto loaded hy-AM and the later raw hy-AM candidate is dropped as a duplicate. The resulting attempted chain leads with the alias TARGET and never contains the requested tag, while the bare 'hy' candidate - which CLDR orders before hy-AM - ends up second. Alias.Missing exists nowhere.
